quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A once-close relationship fading into a single yearly message points to a specific, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: A close relationship slowly reducing to almost nothing is a gentle, familiar form of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: My brother and I used to talk every single day. Now it's a birthday message once a year, if that.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone new catching something that experienced people missed entirely points to real admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone new catching a serious error that experienced people missed is a clear cause of being impressed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
